mapper.sql: d.id, d.student_id, d.post_id, d.application_id, d.work_month, d.total_hours, d.hourly_wage, d.amount, d.assessment, d.status, d.payer_id, d.paid_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, p.name AS post_name, p.unit AS unit

FROM workstudy_payroll d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = d.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = d.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN workstudy_post p ON p.id = d.post_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workstudy_payroll (student_id, post_id, application_id, work_month, total_hours, hourly_wage, amount, assessment, status, payer_id, paid_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{postId}, #{applicationId}, #{workMonth}, #{totalHours}, #{hourlyWage}, #{amount}, #{assessment}, #{status}, #{payerId}, #{paidAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE application_id = VALUES(application_id), total_hours = VALUES(total_hours), hourly_wage = VALUES(hourly_wage), amount = VALUES(amount), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE workstudy_payroll SET status = 'paid', payer_id = #{payerId}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
